summary.text: Teddy Waszazak is a Democratic state representative from Vermont's Washington-3 District who has served since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He works in the nonprofit sector.

paragraphs.text: Teddy Waszazak's career experience includes working as a nonprofit worker.
He assumed office in the Vermont House on January 8, 2025, and advanced from the Democratic primary on August 11, 2026.
